about: Evaluations recorded in a committed batch that are void, with the reason for each. score_confirmatory.py ignores a voided evaluation and evaluates that candidate again. Only evaluations whose slots had not yet been finalized can be voided, so no finalized slot is changed. The batch files themselves are never edited.

voided.name: Indian River State College
voided.reason: 5 NCES finance downloads failed while this candidate was being evaluated (pipeline year labels 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018); the server dropped the connection, so the record reflects a download failure, not the institution's data. Voided before its slot was finalized; the candidate is evaluated again from the cached finance files.
